name: Bidirectional breakdown diode
summary: A bidirectional breakdown diode provides a documented voltage-limiting semiconductor path in both polarities.
description: A bidirectional breakdown diode provides a documented voltage-limiting semiconductor path in both polarities. Its working voltage and surge characteristics determine the protective application.
readingNotes: Read working-voltage and breakdown specifications separately.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Bidirectional protection does not make the component a controllable power switch.
